_about: Labelled (student message, tutor reply) pairs for utils/pipeline/valueLeak.js. leaks=true: the reply hands over the value of the student's own equation. leaks=false: honest tutoring the guard must leave alone — a false alarm rewrites a good reply. The clean half is weighted toward the hard cases: replies full of the problem's own numbers, intermediate results, parallel examples, and answers that collide with a number already in the problem. Add every production false alarm here.
